title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore Auditorium on 1966-11-19

ai_review.summary: Clear soundboard recording of a high‑energy, Pigpen‑heavy show with standout Smokestack Lightning, Midnight Hour and other up‑tempo gems, marred only by slight hiss, occasional pops and an early cut on Dancin' in the Streets.
ai_review.review: The performance bursts with vigor – tight vocals, relentless tempos and Pigpen front‑and‑center on five of twelve numbers, delivering monster versions of Smokestack Lightning, King Bee and an 18‑minute Midnight Hour. The soundboard source is generally clear, though a faint background hiss, occasional crackle/pop and a premature cut of the Dancin' in the Streets solo are noted. Overall it’s a highly enjoyable snapshot of a classic Dead night.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviews overwhelmingly praise the musical performance (high energy, tight playing, many standout songs) and note only minor recording flaws; weighted scoring yields a strong combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Slight background hiss and occasional snap/crackle/pop; no radio interruptions; Dancin' in the Streets cut off about 8 minutes into Jerry's solo; overall clear and listenable.

standout_songs: Beat It On Down the Line
show_quality.setlist_flow: High‑tempo, Pigpen‑driven set with tight transitions (e.g., Smokestack into King Bee) and extended jams; overall flow feels relentless and exhilarating.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for crisp front‑of‑stage presence, dazzling guitar tone on his Guild Starfire, and monster jams on Creampuff War, Dancing in the Streets, Same Thing and Midnight Hour.
band_member_comments.Drums: Mentioned humorously as 'Mr. Bill Summers on drums' and noted as a real treat adding to the high‑energy feel.
